one_line: Central Asian conqueror leading his 1398–1399 campaign into north India.

appearance.age_look: late 50s, broad-shouldered but slightly stooped, solid and battle-hardened
appearance.face: angular face with high cheekbones, weathered light-olive complexion, strong hooked nose, neatly trimmed grey mustache and short beard framing his jaw, a faint scar crossing his left eyebrow, default expression calm and calculating with sharp, narrowed eyes
appearance.hair: short, straight grey hair just visible at the sides and back under a deep red, low-domed Central Asian turban wrapped smoothly with a narrow gold-edged band circling it
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, calf-length Central Asian chapan-style coat in rich royal blue silk with a subtle repeating geometric pattern, the front and sleeve edges trimmed in a narrow band of gold embroidery; under it a deep crimson quilted robe visible at the collar and lower hem; a wide dark brown leather belt with a large rectangular brass buckle cinches his waist and supports his sword; loose cream-colored trousers taper into sturdy dark brown leather boots that reach mid-calf, and a simple dark red wool shawl folds around his shoulders when needed, draping behind him in panels.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved steel saber with a plain brass crossguard and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, sheathed in a dark wooden scabbard with modest brass fittings, worn at his left hip and often lightly gripped at the pommel with one hand.

ref_desc: Timur appears as a late-50s, sharp-eyed Central Asian warlord with short grey hair under a deep red turban, royal blue gold-trimmed chapan over crimson robe, cream trousers, dark brown boots, and a brass-hilted curved saber at his left hip in a royal blue, crimson, cream, dark brown, and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Timur as a dignified Central Asian conqueror in his late 50s: angular face, light-olive weathered skin, high cheekbones, hooked nose, neat grey mustache and short beard, and a faint scar crossing his left eyebrow, with sharp narrowed eyes in a calm, calculating expression. His short grey hair is mostly hidden beneath a deep red low-domed turban wrapped smoothly with a narrow gold-edged band. He wears a calf-length royal blue silk chapan-style coat with a subtle repeating geometric pattern and narrow gold embroidery along the edges of the front opening and sleeves, over a deep crimson quilted robe visible at the collar and lower hem. A wide dark brown leather belt with a rectangular brass buckle cinches his waist and supports a slightly curved steel saber with a plain brass crossguard and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, sheathed in a dark wooden scabbard with modest brass fittings at his left hip. He has loose cream-colored trousers tucked into sturdy dark brown mid-calf leather boots, and a simple dark red wool shawl draped around his shoulders and hanging behind him. Show him standing in a neutral pose, full-body, clearly displaying his face, turban, layered blue-and-crimson garments, belt, boots, shawl, and signature saber, using a palette dominated by royal blue, deep crimson, cream, dark brown, and gold.
